title: Intraday short allocation to member (MCXCCL, INTRASAR)
purpose: Clients whose allocation fell short of the margin at a peak-margin snapshot, for the member to report the reasons back.
linked: Loaded as MCXCCL's intraday short allocations (Clearing data)

columns.name: Intra Short Allocation
columns.note: highest short allocation across the peak snapshots

columns.name: Excess Collateral NCL
columns.note: blank in MCXCCL's file; for member reporting

columns.name: Reserved 9
columns.note: Reserved, Numeric (15,2); ignored if the member reports it (revised by MCX/MCXCCL/327/2026); any value is ignored, so files in the earlier layout read too

columns.name: Against Valid Allocation pending with MCXCCL
Reserved 15
columns.note: Reserved, Numeric (15,2); ignored if the member reports it (revised by MCX/MCXCCL/327/2026); any value is ignored, so files in the earlier layout read too

columns.name: Intrasar Snapshot reference number
columns.note: Numeric (2): the peak snapshot the short allocation is from (revised by MCX/MCXCCL/327/2026); read as text, so files in the earlier layout, whose field 16 differed, read too

source: MCXCCL circular MCX/MCXCCL/327/2026 (MCXCCL/TECH/121/2026, 1 Jun 2026), Revision in Client Margin Reporting File Formats, section 1.1 (fields 9, 15 and 16 revised; 16 fields, as before; live date to be announced by MCXCCL); MCXCCL File Formats (Version 1, Public), section 1.46 Intraday Short Allocation File to Member; MCX circular MCX/TECH/394/2023 (19 Jun 2023), MCX File Formats Version 1.2, section 1.79
